name: Akiba Tomona
source:
After graduating college, she met the protagonist while working as an assistant at the Iwai Detective Agency. Following the head of the agency being detained and the dissolution of the agency, she joined our protagonist in their investigations of mysterious cases across Tokyo. She lost her younger brother during a past case involving a strange series of high school students’ deaths.

[From [url=https://tokyo-psychodemic.com/?lang=en]Official Website[/url]]
